expert_training: Additive and Interaction experts are weighted logistic models; Empirical-Bayes is a shrinkage state estimator. All expert predictions consumed during training are target-group cross-fitted.
statistical_router: For each availability regime, convex probability weights are selected by exhaustive simplex search on OOF weighted log loss. A finer router conditions additionally on observed evidence density when that stratum has at least 120 weighted examples; otherwise it falls back to availability-level weights.
neural_router_control: Experiment 014 neural routed committee, same three statistical experts.
ganglion_test: The availability+density Stat-MoE probability is then used as one derived observer channel beside six biological evidence channels; the shared core remains 16x16.
outcome: Phase 4/approved vs Phase 1/2 under the same target-level external holdout.
